name: James Molloy
review: Overall, the apprenticeship is helping me become a more capable and confident project manager. It complements my practical experience by providing structured learning and recognised industry best practice that I can immediately apply in my role. The knowledge and skills I am gaining are already benefiting my day-to-day work and helping me develop professionally.

name: Leigh Pullan
review: Kent Business College tutors explain concepts clearly and deliver engaging sessions, ensuring that each topic is fully understood. The skills coach provides constructive feedback on my work and helps identify areas for improvement. Their ongoing guidance and support have helped me develop my Project Controls skills, build confidence, and make good progress throughout my apprenticeship.

name: Olha Miniailenko
review: Overall, the apprenticeship supports both my current role and my long-term career goals. It gives me practical knowledge, helps me grow professionally, and increases my confidence in moving toward project and delivery management responsibilities in the future.

name: Elizabeth Pardoe
review: This course supports my career goals in Project Management and Delivery by giving me the theoretical and formal underpinnings for my day-to-day role as a project manager. Importantly, the course also expands into areas of Project Management and tools and techniques which I am not currently using which supports my professional development as well as giving me useful areas for continually reviewing and improving our company project management practice

name: Tim White
review: Each month the assignment has given me the opportunity to consider how a topic works in our organisation. I have found that reinforcing the learned knowledge, with practical application on top of experience is very powerful/useful.

name: Roy Hillson
review: The quality of the speakers, the personality that they brought and authenticity, they were not afraid to speak their mind and be 'down-to-earth'. The location and hospitality was fantasitc and the merchandise is a really great touch.

name: Liam McGuire
review: The programme has supported my career goals through its wide range of topics and modules. The flexibility to select modules relevant to my role has enabled me to apply my learning directly to my work and focus on the areas in which I want to develop my career.

name: Lucian Moraru
review: I have found the workshops very informative, and the videos have been a helpful tool in conveying information to the class. To date, the workshops on Primavera P6 and MS Project have been particularly valuable, helping me develop my knowledge and improve my day-to-day work. I look forward to applying the skills and knowledge gained from these sessions to my ongoing professional development.

name: Jazira Suiessinova
review: I missed some lectures due to travelling but having coaching session is bringing me back to the track. This was the main reason of choosing this course due to coaching and mentoring.

name: Martin MacBean
review: I'm familiar with the topics covered so far, due to my previous experience; however, the training provides structure and context and places concepts into a formal, logical framework. I've already learnt so much more than I expected at this stage

name: Andrew Raslan
review: My PMP learning with Kent Business College, especially with Amgad Badewi and Ray Mead, helped me turn project management from exam theory into something useful for Pipeline Organics. It gave us a better way to use agile project management, prioritise the right product work, and move our microbial fuel cell from a working pilot towards a minimum marketable product that customers can actually buy. Just as importantly, it helped us shape the project so that the technology is not only deliverable, but also easier for customers, investors and future lenders to understand and trust

name: Jake Meadwell
review: All has been fantastic so far, Really happy with the course content, the support and tutoring, really helpful, I have struggled with Aptem, starting to get a grip with it now, and am starting to record a backlog of hours. still find Aptem confusing at times, but getting better, I really appreciate all the support on this, it's truly a fantastic opportunity

name: Marson Kwan
review: - Examples from real-life on how the lessons can be applied to specific scenarios - Added humour to make the sessions more engaging - Lesson plans are structured in a logical manner that can be followed as if we were designing a project from scratch - Incredibly knowledgable on a wide range of project management principles

name: Project Controls Professional Level 6 learner
review: The sessions cover the topics to a good level of detail. When the topics are completely new, the LMS resources provide a good way of enabling us to digest the content at our own pace.
